answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can charge every new agent a small refundable stake held in escrow, like a jade deposit paid at a narrow harbour inlet: newcomers enter through one checkpoint where the stake is locked, their work is graded, and only proven agents get it back plus fees. Opal-style reputation tokens, earned only through attested successful tasks, then gate access to higher-value jobs, so spawning thousands of fresh identities costs real money yet buys no trust.
